prompt: What did the stomach contents of Sardinella tawilis consist of in the zooplankton study?
response: The stomach‑content analysis showed that Sardinella tawilis fed primarily on copepods, which made up about 90 % of the material, while the remaining 10 % consisted of cladocerans and rotifers.<INLINE_CITATION>(Papa & Pagulayan, 2007)</INLINE_CITATION>
